entries.title: Minecraft 26.4 Pre-Release 1
entries.shortText: The first pre-release for 26.4: The Deep Freeze has arrived! We're hard at work squashing bugs, making improvements, and putting the final icy touches on the update ahead of release. Pre-releases don't follow the usual Tuesday snapshot schedule, so stay frosty! You never know when the next update might come sliding in.Happy mining!

entries.title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 10
entries.shortText: We have now released 26.4 Snapshot 10, fixing a crash in the Multiplayer screen.

entries.title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 9
entries.shortText:
26.4 Snapshot 9 is here, bringing data-driven dispensers, Vulkan as the default graphics backend, and a new setting to fine-tune your fog. We've also made improvements to keyboard navigation and narration, alongside a few other tweaks and fixes!

Happy mining!

entries.title: Minecraft 1.20.3
entries.shortText:
We're now releasing 1.20.3 for Minecraft: Java Edition. This release comes with new functionality for Decorated Pots, a new look for the Bat and improvements to Shields.
This release also includes new features for map makers and pack creators like Scoreboa
